correlation/identity.label: Privileged identities
correlation/identity.scope: Existing AD-to-Entra identity links, or proposed matching operations as explicitly required by each check. A candidate match is never treated as an established identity link.
correlation/identity.join: Namespace AD objects by forest and stable GUID/SID; namespace cloud objects by tenant and object ID. Distinguish verified synchronization links from proposed hard/soft matches and resolve actual role scope.

correlation/sync.label: Synchronization infrastructure
correlation/sync.scope: Confirmed Connect Sync or Cloud Sync deployments, including staging systems that still hold privileged configuration or service identities.
correlation/sync.join: Host stable ID -> installed service/agent ID -> connector identity -> forest and tenant IDs; preserve active versus staging roles.

correlation/federation.label: Federation and authentication agents
correlation/federation.scope: Federation, PTA, or Seamless SSO is positively identified for the assessed domains and tenant.
correlation/federation.join: Tenant/domain authentication configuration -> registered issuer/agent -> host and service identity -> controlling principal.

correlation/trust.label: Trust boundaries and remote identity
correlation/trust.scope: A verified trust, external identity, or remote authentication relationship reaches an assessed hybrid asset or cloud resource.
correlation/trust.join: Source forest/tenant -> directional trust and effective authentication permission -> target account/resource -> hybrid destination.

correlation/group.label: Groups and authorization flows
correlation/group.scope: Group or attribute authority demonstrably affects a cloud or on-premises authorization decision across a supported synchronization/provisioning flow.
correlation/group.join: Principal -> effective membership/property write -> source object -> supported provisioning link -> exact target group and grant.

correlation/application.label: Workloads and hybrid applications
correlation/application.scope: Confirmed hybrid application relationships. Arc and Hybrid Worker checks require separately authorized Azure resource-management evidence, not just M365 directory data.
correlation/application.join: Source principal/host -> effective owner or credential-use authority -> tenant-local app/service principal IDs -> resource-specific grants.

correlation/certificate.label: Certificates and PKI
correlation/certificate.scope: An active CA, template, mapping, and relying-party trust establish a path to an identity or host that controls the hybrid environment.
correlation/certificate.join: Enrollment/control principal -> CA/template and issuance constraints -> accepted certificate identity mapping -> AD or Entra target -> sensitive authorization.

correlation/kerberos.label: Kerberos and directory control
correlation/kerberos.scope: An effective AD credential or delegation exposure reaches a verified hybrid administrator, bridge service, or synchronized privileged identity.
correlation/kerberos.join: Controlling principal -> effective AD authentication/delegation condition -> specific target account/service -> hybrid privilege link.

correlation/host.label: Administrative access to hybrid hosts
correlation/host.scope: Confirmed bridge, CA, DC, or privileged management hosts in the assessment scope; remote access is evaluated only from authorized configuration evidence.
correlation/host.join: Principal/source zone -> effective network and logon authorization -> host/service -> active hybrid responsibility.

correlation/policy.label: Policy and host configuration paths
correlation/policy.scope: Effective Windows/GPO configuration influences hosts or identities with a demonstrated hybrid responsibility.
correlation/policy.join: Configuration writer or specific weakness -> effective setting on target -> privileged hybrid service/account -> cloud impact context.

correlation/visibility.label: Visibility along a hybrid path
correlation/visibility.scope: A separately evidenced hybrid exposure exists and the relevant detection/audit coverage is assessed against an explicit organizational requirement.
correlation/visibility.join: Existing path/finding ID -> affected objects and expected event source -> effective audit configuration -> independently protected destination.

correlation/recovery.label: Containment and recovery
correlation/recovery.scope: Hybrid assets and their actual backup, emergency access, deprovisioning, or recovery dependencies are in scope; attestations are explicitly marked.
correlation/recovery.join: Hybrid control path -> recovery or containment dependency -> controlling identity/store -> independent recovery capability and evidence.

posture/directory.label: Supporting AD posture
posture/directory.scope: Authorized AD forest/domain collection with complete relevant scope; these observations support correlation and do not themselves prove cloud impact.
posture/directory.join: Domain/forest stable identity -> object SID/GUID -> effective policy or authorization scope.

posture/auth.label: Supporting authentication posture
posture/auth.scope: Effective authentication configuration is assessed by OS build, server role, service scope, and an explicitly selected baseline.
posture/auth.join: Host/domain stable identity -> effective configuration and policy precedence -> applicable baseline requirement.

posture/server.label: Supporting Windows Server posture
posture/server.scope: Read-only host collection is authorized for the specific target; domain-controller and member-server profiles are selected separately.
posture/server.join: Host stable identity -> installed role/build -> effective host setting -> selected baseline profile.

posture/operations.label: Supporting identity operations
posture/operations.scope: Authoritative inventory and dated operational requirements are available; owner attestations are retained separately from machine observations.
posture/operations.join: Stable object/service identity -> responsible owner and requirement -> dated activity/configuration evidence.
